split_method: Seed-42 source families plus mirrored dHash radius-3 components; known kitchen CCTV and office families in train; food-production media held out unless connected to train
limitations: Mixed kitchen, office, food-production and stock imagery; not an all-kitchen benchmark
Source identification is heuristic and incomplete
Known kitchen CCTV retained entirely in train; held-out set is not independent college-kitchen footage
Near-duplicate hashing can overmerge sources and cannot guarantee independence
Both public datasets may share images; start from general YOLO weights, not the old fine-tuned checkpoint
